title: Joyful
slide_intent: Teach communicators to make joy visible through a specific moment so the audience can recognize the feeling for itself.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can connect its upbeat voice to a shared sporting experience.
demonstration: People in yellow and black jump together outdoors. The red trait heading and two copy blocks associate that moment with an uplifting tone.
practical_value: Choose a photograph with an observable expression of joy and write in a tone consistent with the action.

content_islands.name: Photographic example
content_islands.spec: Use the outdoor group photograph at full scale. Preserve the raised arms, airborne figures and water.

content_islands.name: Trait heading
content_islands.spec: Position the Joyful bar above the lower-left copy panel.

content_islands.name: Meaning and expression
content_islands.spec: In two columns, pair the value of joy with guidance on an upbeat voice. Keep enough contrast for the copy over the active image.
